01 / ONE-OFF PROJECT

Practice Security Review

A planned standalone engagement for solo therapists and small practices. No subscription is required.

Proposed scope

  • Inventory of agreed accounts, devices and suppliers.
  • Account-security discussion and permissioned configuration checks where explicitly scoped.
  • Access and recovery responsibilities.
  • Prioritised improvement recommendations.

What you receive

A written report showing evidence, unknowns, recommended actions and owners, followed by a scoped handover.

Not automatically included: implementation, intrusive testing, supplier-system access, certification, insurance or ongoing monitoring.

Choose the depth of the one-off review

Bronze, Silver and Gold are proposed scope options within the standalone review, not subscriptions. Availability, named systems, delivery owner and fees must be agreed before purchase.

BRONZE · FOUNDATIONS

Understand your setup

Account and supplier inventory, security questionnaire and prioritised checklist. A practical starting point without assuming internal access.

SILVER · ACCOUNT REVIEW

Check agreed settings

Foundations plus explicitly permissioned configuration checks, access and recovery responsibilities, with documented findings and an improvement plan.

GOLD · RECOVERY READINESS

Prepare for disruption

Account review plus response contacts, recovery priorities and a practical continuity plan. Follow-up work is separately scoped, not an automatic subscription.

No tier automatically includes intrusive testing, hands-on fixes, certification, insurance, the dashboard or an AI assistant. These require separately confirmed capability and scope.

Before acceptance, confirm the delivery person, account limits, access, timetable, fees and exclusions. Hands-on changes require separate approval and scope.

02 / OPTIONAL MONTHLY ARRANGEMENT

Practice Security Care

A planned option for practices that want regular follow-through. It is not required after a one-off review and does not renew or start automatically.

Proposed monthly work

  • Agreed recurring account or configuration checks.
  • Review of system changes and outstanding actions.
  • Monthly plain-English progress report.
  • Updated action register and defined advisory follow-up.

What must be agreed

Included systems, work and hours; reporting dates; delivery owner; support availability; extra-work rates; minimum term, renewal and cancellation arrangements.

Not a 24/7 service: no continuous staffed monitoring, emergency response or response-time guarantee is currently offered.

Specialist testing, remediation, certification and insurance are not automatically included. The roadmap below describes possibilities, not a monthly entitlement.

Both packages are planned, not yet available to purchase.

Delivery capability, prices and commercial terms remain to be confirmed. A written agreement must define the actual work before any engagement. You can choose a one-off project without committing to monthly care.

PLANNED CAPABILITIES · NOT YET AVAILABLE

A broader protection programme.
Built with clear responsibilities.

We are exploring the following additions to our practice reviews. They are not included in either planned package or available to purchase. Launch depends on qualified delivery, suitable tools and agreed terms.

Vulnerability scanning

Planned scheduled checks of specifically authorised devices and internet-facing assets, with findings reviewed for relevance. A scan is not a penetration test or proof that every weakness has been found.

Before launch: named asset limits, owner permission, scanning windows, tool licensing and triage responsibilities.

Monthly penetration testing

A proposed specialist option, not a default requirement for every therapist. Any monthly cadence would need a clear risk-based purpose and separately agreed test scope, limits, safety controls and retesting arrangements.

Before launch: qualified testers, written authorisation, supplier permissions where needed, incident contacts and delivery capacity. No intrusive testing is offered through this website.

Dark-web exposure monitoring

A planned service to check approved business identifiers against a provider’s available breach-exposure sources and help interpret alerts. Coverage is incomplete; an alert does not establish current account compromise, and no alert does not establish safety.

Before launch: vetted provider, lawful data handling, approved identifiers, retention policy and alert-response ownership. We would not test exposed credentials.

Monthly security reports

Proposed plain-English summaries of completed checks, evidence, outstanding actions and changes since the previous review. Each report would distinguish assessed systems from unknowns.

Before launch: agreed data sources, review hours, reporting dates and a named person responsible for follow-up. Monthly reporting is not continuous staffed monitoring.

Security remediation

Planned support for agreed configuration changes and updates, working with the practice and existing IT provider. Fixes require assessment and change approval; some issues may depend on a supplier or need separate work.

Before launch: competent delivery, backups, rollback planning, maintenance windows, included hours and completion checks. No guarantee that every finding can be fixed.

Annual Cyber Essentials support

A proposed preparation and renewal-coordination service. Cyber Essentials is annually renewable; assessment and certification must follow the scheme’s authorised route. Preparation is not certification.

Before launch: delivery capability and a confirmed certification route, with assessment fees and remediation costs stated separately. Cyber Defender is not claiming Certification Body or assured-adviser status.

Read IASME’s scheme information ↗

Cyber insurance guidance

Our existing guide explains questions to ask a suitably authorised insurer or broker. Cyber Defender does not currently sell, arrange or provide insurance, and no policy is included in the proposed packages.

Any future insurance-related offering would need a confirmed, appropriate arrangement. Separate Cyber Essentials-linked benefits depend on eligibility, opt-in and policy terms.

No prices, response guarantees or launch dates have been set for these additions. Do not rely on this page for incident response. Testing and remediation would require written scope and appropriately qualified delivery.
